iti8:1.1: vuttaṃ hetaṃ bhagavatā. vuttamarahatā’ti me sutaṃ:
iti8:2.1: mānaṃ bhikkhave anabhijānaṃ aparijānaṃ tattha cittaṃ avirājayaṃ appajahaṃ abhabbo dukkhakkhayāya.
iti8:2.2: mānaṃ ca kho bhikkhave abhijānaṃ parijānaṃ tattha cittaṃ virājayaṃ pajahaṃ bhabbo dukkhakkhayāyā’ti.
iti8:5.1: ayampi attho vutto bhagavatā, iti me sutanti.
